- Primary goals for the deep-dive: throughput profiling, KV/cache strategy, and network egress/data residency constraints for PHI.

Proposed next steps (pick one window):
1) Tue Aug 3, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 PT (17:00–18:00 UTC)
2) Wed Aug 4, 2026 — 08:00–09:00 PT (15:00–16:00 UTC)
3) Thu Aug 5, 2026 — 13:00–14:00 PT (20:00–21:00 UTC)

Please confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (you mentioned a CTO and an infra lead). We typically run a 45–60 minute session: 20 minutes on architecture + 25–35 minutes of live profiling/ops questions.

Format: we can use Google Meet (we prefer a Meet link for recording and Drive notes) or Zoom if you need waiting-room/SSO. Which do you prefer?

Attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (high-level runbook).

If the team has any compliance docs/allowlist requirements for VPC or SSO ahead of the call, please drop them in reply. Ben will lead the technical walkthrough from our side.

Cheers,
